invented.quote: He has also taken on more than his job requires.
invented.why: The brief does not state whether learning the herd management software and flagging sick cows were outside of his required job duties.

invented.quote: When we brought in our herd management software, Tomás learned it on his own initiative.
invented.why: The brief only states that he learned the software, not when the farm brought it in or that he learned it on his own initiative rather than being assigned to learn it.

invented.quote: He did not need anyone to tell him to do that.
invented.why: The brief only states that he is taking a night class for his written English, not whether he did so without being told.
